storageContract.completion: Writes only after an explicit action, in the existing acknowledged persistence queue; all-absent state is checked again inside the queued transformation.
storageContract.existingLibrary: Any present raw key, including empty, malformed and unknown text, or any typed progress skips onboarding. A read failure is not treated as absence.
storageContract.backup: Existing complete raw snapshot/audiovisual backup carries the field without a format change. Exact restored raw data is not rewritten just to mark onboarding complete.
storageContract.emptyRestore: A fully absent restored snapshot enters the library for that session; reopening may invite first access again because the restored copy contains no completion record.
storageContract.unknownFields: Unsupported versions, future fields and reduced projections remain guarded; neither onboarding nor settings normalize them into defaults.
storageContract.downgrade: Earlier preference decoders see the extra field as a guarded projection and cannot silently overwrite it; no downgrade requested.
